intro: The Rêve study table is where little ideas take flight. With its soft dual-tone finish, rounded corners, and practical storage, it creates a bright, comforting workspace for learning and creativity.

features.title: Dual tone finish for soft visual warmth
features.text: The combination of Swiss white and Sonoma oak introduces brightness and gentle contrast in the Reve study table. This pairing brings both lightness and comfort into study corners.

features.title: Rounded corners for everyday safety
features.text: Filleted edges soften the table’s silhouette, making it safe and inviting for children. The table’s tender, cloud-like form enhances both aesthetics and peace of mind.

features.title: Spacious tabletop for focused creativity
features.text: Reve’s wide surface offers ample space for books, art supplies, and schoolwork. The generous tabletop encourages doodles, discoveries, and quiet concentration.

features.title: Drawer and cupboard storage for tidy organisation
features.text: The table’s compact drawer keeps pencils and small essentials within reach, while a hinged cupboard provides storage for books or a school bag. These thoughtful compartments maintain a clutter-free workspace.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
